items.summary: Rescan with the fixed scan_nvidia: 12 files carry the pre-2017 CUDA samples EULA-pointer notice -- the vendored src/include/helper_*.h set AND h2o4gpu's own src/gpu/bwcheck.cu and src/include/exception.h, which copied the header.
